title.en: Past of be: was and were
title.es: Pasado de be: was y were

summary.en: The past of **be** has two forms: **was** (I, he, she, it) and **were** (you, we, they). Use it to say where or how someone or something was, or what it was like: _I was at home. The shops were closed. How was the film?_ Questions and negatives do not use _did_: _Were you ill? I wasn't ill._
summary.es: Was (I, he, she, it) y were (you, we, they) cubren «era, fue, estaba, estuvo». Preguntas y negativas se hacen con el propio verbo, sin did.

form: **I / he / she / it + was**: _I was tired. It was cold._
**You / we / they + were**: _We were late. They were friendly._
Negatives: **wasn't / weren't**: _He wasn't at work. They weren't happy._
Questions: **Was / Were** + subject: _Was she ill? Were you at the party?_
Short answers: _Yes, I was. / No, we weren't._ Time words: **yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2019**.

uses.text: **Where someone or something was** → _We were in Lisbon last weekend._
**How someone felt or what something was like** → _I was very nervous. The food was excellent._
**Saying where and when you were born** → _I was born in Zaragoza in 1994._

note.en: Born is always used with was or were, as an adjective.
note.es: Con born se usa siempre was/were: «nací» = I was born.

uses.text: **There was / there were** → _There was a long queue. There were two messages for you._

why.en: We, you and they take were.
why.es: We, you y they llevan were.

why.en: Born needs was or were: I was born.
why.es: «Nací» = I was born; hace falta was.

why.en: The past of be makes its own questions. Do not add did.
why.es: Be hace sus preguntas solo: Were you…? Sin did.

why.en: The past negative of be is wasn't or weren't.
why.es: La negativa es wasn't / weren't, sin didn't.

why.en: Shops is plural (they), so use were.

examples.en: I was at the dentist's yesterday morning.
examples.es: Ayer por la mañana estuve en el dentista.

examples.en: The hotel was clean, but the rooms were small.
examples.es: El hotel estaba limpio, pero las habitaciones eran pequeñas.

examples.en: Were you at work on Friday? No, I was on holiday.
How was your weekend? It was great, thanks.
examples.es: ¿Qué tal el fin de semana? Genial, gracias.

examples.en: My grandparents were born in a small village.
She wasn't happy with the result.
We weren't in the office when the call came.
There was a problem with the printer this morning.
Was the exam difficult? Not really.
They were very kind to us last summer.

practice.prompt: We ___ very tired after the long journey.

explanation.en: We takes were, and the journey is finished.

practice.prompt: ___ your sister at the party last night?

explanation.en: Your sister is she, so the question starts with was.

practice.prompt: The tickets ___ expensive, so we bought two.

explanation.en: Tickets is plural, so the negative is weren't.
My father is he, and born uses the past form was.
